controls_present: SSRF protection via DNS resolution and private/link-local IP range blocklist (isPrivateIp)
Protocol allowlist (http/https only) via zod refine
Header value CRLF/control character stripping before use and before logging
Structured JSON logging with sanitized fields
Blocked sensitive headers (authorization, cookie, etc.) on outbound and inbound
other_classes_observed: TOCTOU DNS rebinding: isPrivateIp resolves hostname separately from the later fetch(targetUrl), so DNS could change between check and use
Rate limiter is in-memory only, ineffective across multiple server instances
